name: 问题偶像的养成计划
detailed_description:
Welcome to the private performing arts college full of love and dreams - Xingmengdian~!

The sweat of youth and dreams is sprinkled in every corner of the college. Come and experience a happy and colorful campus life with the idols you meet!

In the distance, someone's voice came into my ears...

Game type:

"Problem Idol Cultivation Plan" is a visual novel adventure game.

The gameplay is mainly based on promoting the plot. Players can choose different options from them and finally usher in different endings.

Game features:

The game is divided into three different time periods in the morning, noon and afternoon. Players can choose one of the idol teams to accompany and communicate and discover the secrets that are really hidden in their hearts.

Brief introduction of the story:

The story goes back to a fictional coastal town in Japan in September 2015.

As the protagonist, Buchuan Maqiu transferred to this private Xingmengdian College.

There,

She met all kinds of new partners and started a new life that belonged to her--

Character introduction:

Buchuan Maqiu

Sophomore in high school (17 years old)

Without knowing anything about idols and the entertainment industry, he was arranged by his grandfather to transfer to the private Xingmengdian College built by his friend.

Kuandao Silver

The third year of high school (18 years old)

The main C member of the idol group - fantasy.

Served as the vice president of the current student union and the head of the basketball department.

Unlike the president, he is kind and gentle, so he has a large social circle in the school.

Anna. Lisa

The third year of high school (18 years old)

Members of the idol group - fantasy.

The real second generation of stars has a wide range of hobbies and has his own views on knowledge.

However, because he is too poisonous, the school's reputation is mediocre.

Naiyoucun Tatakai

The third year of high school (18 years old)

The captain of the idol group - fantasy.

Buchuan Maqiu's childhood sweetheart.

At the same time, he is also the current president of the student union. He is proficient in tea ceremony archery. His family is a martial arts family, and he is also respected in school.

Ping An Leon

Sophomore in high school (17 years old)

The captain of the idol group -Bangbang.

He claimed to be the president of the school's mystery club, but he seemed to be the only one in the whole club.

Sincere and enthusiastic, a typical representative of the optimistic school.

Ryder. Cassano

Sophomore in high school (17 years old)

Members of the idol group -Bangbang.

I am a heavy home culture lover, and I am also a super current charger. I like to play social accounts very much.

He is very good at cooking and is very popular with girls in school.

Jian Shun

First year of high school (16 years old)

The captain of the idol group - blackdacon.

Living with his younger brother, he has strong mobility and intuition.

I didn't join any club at school.

Jian Yong

First year of high school (16 years old)

A member of the idol group - blackdacon.

Shun's younger brother is a strange teenager who always walks around holding rabbit dolls.

I have an unexpected personality.
